en.summary: This commit fixes batched memory scheduling so empty sub-batches are skipped instead of blocking the queue head.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says it fixes a memory scheduler bug.
The patch changes core issue control inside VX_mem_scheduler.
The fix addresses a real progress bug where a batch with no active lanes can stall request advancement.
disqualifiers: The same commit also contains trace-string cleanup that is not part of the bug fix.
evidence: The patch adds is_degenerate_batch, mem_req_valid_b, and mem_req_ready_b in the MEM_BATCHES != 1 path.
req_batch_idx_r and req_sent_all are now advanced using mem_req_ready_b, which treats empty batches as immediately consumable.
Before the fix, mem_req_valid_s was tied directly to reqq_valid_s even when the selected batch mask was all zeros.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A coalescing or batched memory scheduler may decompose one logical request into several sub-batches. Some sub-batches can contain no active lanes or bytes. If the scheduler still treats that empty batch as a normal downstream transaction that needs a ready handshake, the queue head can stop advancing even though there is nothing to issue.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The current sub-batch selected for issue has an all-zero activity mask while later sub-batches in the same logical request still exist or the head entry still needs to retire.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Require a normal downstream ready/valid transaction for the empty sub-batch instead of auto-skipping it locally.
portability_notes: This maps to vector lane coalescers, burst fragmenters, or any scheduler that walks a per-request batch index.
The core portability hook is the per-batch activity mask, not the specific bus protocol.
Leaving later non-empty batches intact makes the resulting stall easier to observe.
concrete_injection_steps: Drive sub-batch valid directly from queue-head valid even when the selected batch has no active work.
Advance the batch index only when the downstream interface returns ready, not when the batch is detected as empty.
Keep the end-of-request retirement logic tied to that same downstream handshake.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix detects all-zero sub-batches, suppresses their outgoing valid signal, and treats them as immediately ready so req_batch_idx can advance.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove is_degenerate_batch and mem_req_ready_b, then drive mem_req_valid_s directly from reqq_valid_s and req_sent_all from mem_req_ready_s again.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A logical request whose current batch has no active lanes can block batch-index progression and stall the memory scheduler.
evidence_for_injection: The patch only touches the batch-walking logic and adds explicit zero-mask handling.
The fixed code still scans for the last non-empty batch, which confirms that empty batches are a first-class scheduler case rather than a test artifact.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了批量内存调度逻辑，使空子批次会被直接跳过，而不会把队头请求卡住。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确写明修复 memory scheduler bug。
补丁修改了 VX_mem_scheduler 内部的核心发射控制。
修复解决了真实的前进性问题：没有任何有效 lane 的批次会阻塞请求推进。
disqualifiers: 同一提交里还带有与本缺陷无关的 trace 字符串清理。
evidence: 补丁在 MEM_BATCHES != 1 路径中新增了 is_degenerate_batch、mem_req_valid_b 和 mem_req_ready_b。
req_batch_idx_r 与 req_sent_all 现在基于 mem_req_ready_b 推进，这会把空批次视为可立即消费。
修复前 mem_req_valid_s 直接等于 reqq_valid_s，即使当前选中的 batch mask 全为零也会照常参与发射。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 聚合型或分批型内存调度器常常会把一个逻辑请求拆成多个子批次。某些子批次可能完全没有有效 lane 或有效字节。如果调度器仍把这种空批次当成需要正常 ready 握手的下游事务，那么即使实际上没有任何要发出的工作，请求队头也会停止前进。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 当前被选中发射的子批次活动掩码全零，而同一逻辑请求后面仍有其他子批次，或该队头请求仍需退休。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让空子批次也必须走一次正常的下游 ready/valid 事务，而不是在本地直接跳过。
portability_notes: 可映射到向量 lane 合并器、burst fragmenter，或任何按每请求批次索引前进的调度器。
可移植的关键是“每批次活动掩码”，而不是具体总线协议。
保留后续非空批次不变，更容易观察到由空批次造成的停滞。
concrete_injection_steps: 即使当前批次没有任何有效工作，也让其 valid 仍直接跟随队头 valid。
只有在下游接口返回 ready 时才推进批次索引，而不是在本地检测到空批次时推进。
让整条逻辑请求的退休条件继续依赖同一个下游握手。

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复通过检测全零子批次、抑制其输出 valid，并把它们视为立即 ready，从而允许 req_batch_idx 前进。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 is_degenerate_batch 与 mem_req_ready_b，并让 mem_req_valid_s 再次直接来自 reqq_valid_s，同时让 req_sent_all 再次只依赖 mem_req_ready_s。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 当逻辑请求当前批次没有任何有效 lane 时，batch 索引无法继续推进，内存调度器会被卡住。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁只改动了批次推进逻辑，并新增了显式的零掩码处理。
修复后的代码仍会查找最后一个非空 batch，这表明空批次是调度器必须正确处理的真实场景，而不是测试伪象。
